<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>thehruniverse.com — The HR's Universe by Recruvate</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Archivo:wght@500;700;900&family=Caveat:wght@600;700&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --cream:#F7F0E4;
    --cream-2:#EFE6D6;
    --ink:#171522;
    --ink-soft:#4A4658;
    --orange-1:#EE5C2B;
    --orange-2:#FF9142;
    --blue:#2E5AA8;
    --green:#2C7A4B;
    --purple:#6E4CC9;
    --line: rgba(23,21,34,0.12);
    --radius: 18px;
  }

  *{box-sizing:border-box; margin:0; padding:0;}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
  body{
    background:var(--cream);
    color:var(--ink);
    font-family:'Inter', sans-serif;
    line-height:1.5;
    overflow-x:hidden;
  }
  img{max-width:100%; display:block;}

  h1,h2,h3{
    font-family:'Archivo', sans-serif;
    font-weight:900;
    letter-spacing:-0.01em;
    line-height:1.02;
  }
  .script{
    font-family:'Caveat', cursive;
    font-weight:700;
  }
  .eyebrow{
    font-family:'Inter', sans-serif;
    font-weight:700;
    font-size:0.72rem;
    letter-spacing:0.18em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--orange-1);
  }
  a{color:inherit; text-decoration:none;}
  .wrap{
    max-width:1120px;
    margin:0 auto;
    padding:0 32px;
  }

  /* ---------- reveal on scroll ---------- */
  .reveal{
    opacity:0;
    transform:translateY(22px);
    transition:opacity .7s ease, transform .7s ease;
  }
  .reveal.in{
    opacity:1;
    transform:translateY(0);
  }

  /* ---------- NAV ---------- */
  .nav{
    position:sticky; top:0; z-index:50;
    background:rgba(247,240,228,0.86);
    backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .nav-inner{
    max-width:1120px; margin:0 auto; padding:16px 32px;
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
  }
  .brand{
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;
    font-family:'Archivo', sans-serif; font-weight:900; font-size:1.05rem;
  }
  .brand .dot{
    width:9px; height:9px; border-radius:50%;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg, var(--orange-1), var(--orange-2));
  }
  .brand small{
    display:block; font-family:'Inter',sans-serif; font-weight:600;
    font-size:0.6rem; letter-spacing:0.14em; color:var(--ink-soft); text-transform:uppercase;
  }
  .nav-cta{
    background:var(--ink); color:var(--cream);
    padding:10px 20px; border-radius:999px;
    font-weight:600; font-size:0.85rem;
    transition:transform .25s ease, background .25s ease;
  }
  .nav-cta:hover{ background:var(--orange-1); transform:translateY(-2px); }

  /* ---------- HERO ---------- */
  .hero{
    position:relative;
    padding:96px 0 64px;
    overflow:hidden;
  }
  .hero-inner{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1.15fr 0.85fr;
    gap:56px;
    align-items:start;
  }
  .hero h1{
    font-size:clamp(2.6rem, 5.4vw, 4.4rem);
    margin-top:14px;
  }
  .hero h1 .accent{
    background:linear-gradient(100deg, var(--orange-1), var(--orange-2), var(--orange-1));
    background-size:200% auto;
    -webkit-background-clip:text;
    background-clip:text;
    color:transparent;
    animation: shimmer 4s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes shimmer{
    0%,100%{ background-position:0% center; }
    50%{ background-position:100% center; }
  }
  .hero h1 .script-accent{
    font-size:1.15em;
    color:var(--ink);
    display:inline-block;
    transform:rotate(-2deg);
  }
  .hero p.lead{
    margin-top:22px;
    font-size:1.12rem;
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    max-width:52ch;
  }
  .hero-bullets{
    margin-top:22px;
    max-width:52ch;
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    gap:12px;
  }
  .hero-bullets li{
    list-style:none;
    font-size:0.98rem;
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    line-height:1.5;
    padding-left:22px;
    position:relative;
  }
  .hero-bullets li::before{
    content:'';
    position:absolute; left:0; top:9px;
    width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg, var(--orange-1), var(--orange-2));
  }
  .hero-bullets li strong{ color:var(--ink); font-weight:700; }
  .hero-ctas{
    margin-top:34px;
    display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:14px;
  }
  .btn{
    display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;
    padding:14px 26px;
    border-radius:999px;
    font-weight:700;
    font-size:0.95rem;
    transition:transform .25s ease, box-shadow .25s ease, background .25s ease;
    border:1.5px solid transparent;
  }
  .btn-primary{
    background:linear-gradient(100deg, var(--orange-1), var(--orange-2));
    color:#fff;
    box-shadow:0 10px 24px -10px rgba(238,92,43,0.6);
  }
  .btn-primary:hover{ transform:translateY(-3px); box-shadow:0 14px 30px -10px rgba(238,92,43,0.7); }
  .btn-ghost{
    border-color:var(--ink);
    color:var(--ink);
  }
  .btn-ghost:hover{ background:var(--ink); color:var(--cream); }

  .social-row{
    margin-top:30px;
    display:flex;
    gap:12px;
  }
  .social-icon{
    width:44px; height:44px;
    border-radius:50%;
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    background:#fff;
    box-shadow:0 8px 20px -9px rgba(23,21,34,0.4);
    transition:transform .25s ease, box-shadow .25s ease;
  }
  .social-icon:hover{ transform:translateY(-3px); box-shadow:0 12px 26px -8px rgba(23,21,34,0.45); }
  .social-icon svg{ width:24px; height:24px; }

  @keyframes blink{
    0%,100%{ opacity:1; }
    50%{ opacity:0.25; }
  }

  /* ---------- STATEMENT ---------- */
  .statement{
    background:var(--ink);
    color:var(--cream);
    padding:100px 0;
    position:relative;
  }
  .statement .wrap{ max-width:820px; }
  .statement p{
    font-family:'Archivo', sans-serif;
    font-weight:500;
    font-size:clamp(1.3rem, 2.6vw, 1.85rem);
    line-height:1.42;
    color:#EDE8F5;
  }
  .statement p + p{ margin-top:22px; }
  .statement .highlight{
    color:var(--orange-2);
    font-weight:700;
  }
  .statement .script{
    color: #C9BFF0;
    font-size:1.25em;
  }

  /* ---------- MARQUEE ---------- */
  .marquee{
    background:var(--ink);
    border-top:1px solid rgba(247,240,228,0.12);
    border-bottom:1px solid rgba(247,240,228,0.12);
    overflow:hidden;
    padding:16px 0;
  }
  .marquee-track{
    display:flex;
    width:max-content;
    animation: scroll-left 22s linear infinite;
  }
  .marquee-track span{
    font-family:'Archivo', sans-serif;
    font-weight:800;
    font-size:1.1rem;
    color:#EDE8F5;
    white-space:nowrap;
    padding:0 28px;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:28px;
  }
  .marquee-track span.dim{ color: var(--orange-2); }
  @keyframes scroll-left{
    0%{ transform:translateX(0); }
    100%{ transform:translateX(-50%); }
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
    .marquee-track{ animation:none; }
  }

  /* ---------- SCROLL PROGRESS ---------- */
  .progress-bar{
    position:fixed;
    top:0; left:0;
    height:3px;
    width:0%;
    background:linear-gradient(90deg, var(--orange-1), var(--orange-2));
    z-index:100;
    transition:width .1s ease-out;
  }

  /* ---------- ABOUT ---------- */
  .about-grid{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 1fr;
    gap:56px;
    align-items:start;
  }
  .about-copy p{
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    font-size:1.03rem;
    max-width:56ch;
  }
  .about-copy p + p{ margin-top:16px; }
  .about-tags{
    margin-top:26px;
    display:flex;
    flex-wrap:wrap;
    gap:10px;
  }
  .about-tags span{
    padding:8px 16px;
    border-radius:999px;
    border:1.5px solid var(--line);
    font-size:0.85rem;
    font-weight:600;
    color:var(--ink);
    background:#fff;
    transition: transform .3s ease, border-color .3s ease, background .3s ease, color .3s ease;
  }
  .about-tags span:hover{
    transform:translateY(-3px);
    border-color:var(--orange-1);
    background:var(--orange-1);
    color:#fff;
  }
  .stat-card{
    background:linear-gradient(160deg, #1E1B2E, #0F0D18);
    border-radius:24px;
    padding:38px 32px;
    color:var(--cream);
    position:relative;
    overflow:hidden;
  }
  .stat-card::before{
    content:'';
    position:absolute;
    width:220px; height:220px;
    border-radius:50%;
    background:radial-gradient(circle, rgba(238,92,43,0.35), transparent 70%);
    top:-70px; right:-70px;
  }
  .stat-number{
    font-family:'Archivo', sans-serif;
    font-weight:900;
    font-size:4.2rem;
    line-height:1;
    background:linear-gradient(100deg, var(--orange-1), var(--orange-2));
    -webkit-background-clip:text;
    background-clip:text;
    color:transparent;
    position:relative;
  }
  .stat-label{
    margin-top:10px;
    font-weight:700;
    font-size:1rem;
    color:#EDE8F5;
    position:relative;
  }
  .stat-note{
    margin-top:16px;
    font-size:0.85rem;
    color:#9C97B5;
    position:relative;
    line-height:1.55;
  }
  .stat-since{
    display:inline-flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:8px;
    margin-top:26px;
    padding-top:22px;
    border-top:1px solid rgba(247,240,228,0.14);
    font-size:0.85rem;
    font-weight:600;
    color:#EDE8F5;
    position:relative;
  }
  .stat-since .dot-pulse{
    width:8px; height:8px;
    border-radius:50%;
    background:var(--orange-2);
    animation: blink 1.6s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @media (max-width: 860px){
    .about-grid{ grid-template-columns:1fr; }
  }

  .section{ padding:90px 0; }
  .section-head{
    max-width:640px;
    margin-bottom:52px;
  }
  .section-head h2{
    font-size:clamp(1.9rem, 3.4vw, 2.6rem);
    margin-top:10px;
  }
  .section-head p{
    margin-top:16px;
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    font-size:1.05rem;
  }

  /* ---------- BENEFITS ---------- */
  .benefits{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap:20px;
  }
  .benefit{
    background:#fff;
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius:var(--radius);
    padding:28px 22px;
    transition:transform .3s ease, box-shadow .3s ease;
  }
  .benefit:hover{
    transform:translateY(-6px);
    box-shadow:0 18px 34px -18px rgba(23,21,34,0.25);
  }
  .benefit-icon{
    width:46px; height:46px;
    border-radius:12px;
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    margin-bottom:18px;
    font-size:1.3rem;
    transition: transform .4s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1);
  }
  .benefit:hover .benefit-icon{
    transform: scale(1.15) rotate(-6deg);
  }
  .benefit h3{
    font-family:'Archivo', sans-serif;
    font-weight:800;
    font-size:1.05rem;
    line-height:1.25;
  }
  .benefit p{
    margin-top:10px;
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    font-size:0.92rem;
  }
  .b-orange .benefit-icon{ background:rgba(238,92,43,0.12); color:var(--orange-1); }
  .b-blue .benefit-icon{ background:rgba(46,90,168,0.12); color:var(--blue); }
  .b-green .benefit-icon{ background:rgba(44,122,75,0.12); color:var(--green); }
  .b-purple .benefit-icon{ background:rgba(110,76,201,0.12); color:var(--purple); }

  /* ---------- HOW IT WORKS ---------- */
  .steps{
    background:var(--cream-2);
  }
  .step-list{
    display:grid;
    gap:0;
  }
  .step{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:64px 1fr;
    gap:22px;
    padding:26px 0;
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
    align-items:flex-start;
  }
  .step:last-child{ border-bottom:none; }
  .step-signal{
    display:flex; align-items:flex-end; gap:3px; height:34px;
  }
  .step-signal span{
    width:5px;
    border-radius:3px;
    background:var(--orange-1);
    opacity:0.35;
  }
  .step[data-level="1"] .step-signal span:nth-child(1){ opacity:1; }
  .step[data-level="2"] .step-signal span:nth-child(-n+2){ opacity:1; }
  .step[data-level="3"] .step-signal span:nth-child(-n+3){ opacity:1; }
  .step[data-level="4"] .step-signal span{ opacity:1; }
  .step-signal span:nth-child(1){ height:10px; }
  .step-signal span:nth-child(2){ height:18px; }
  .step-signal span:nth-child(3){ height:26px; }
  .step-signal span:nth-child(4){ height:34px; }
  .step[data-level="4"] .step-signal span{
    animation: eq 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .step[data-level="4"] .step-signal span:nth-child(2){ animation-delay:.15s; }
  .step[data-level="4"] .step-signal span:nth-child(3){ animation-delay:.3s; }
  .step[data-level="4"] .step-signal span:nth-child(4){ animation-delay:.45s; }
  @keyframes eq{
    0%,100%{ transform:scaleY(1); }
    50%{ transform:scaleY(0.55); }
  }
  .step h3{
    font-family:'Archivo', sans-serif;
    font-size:1.15rem;
    font-weight:800;
  }
  .step p{
    margin-top:6px;
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    font-size:0.96rem;
    max-width:56ch;
  }

  /* ---------- HOST ---------- */
  .host{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns: 220px 1fr;
    gap:40px;
    align-items:center;
    background:#fff;
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius:24px;
    padding:40px;
  }
  .host-photo{
    position:relative;
    width:100%;
    aspect-ratio:1/1;
    border-radius:50%;
    background:linear-gradient(160deg, var(--orange-1), var(--purple));
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    overflow:hidden;
    padding:5px;
  }
  .host-photo::after{
    content:'';
    position:absolute;
    inset:-8px;
    border-radius:50%;
    border:1.5px solid var(--orange-1);
    animation: ring-pulse 2.6s ease-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes ring-pulse{
    0%{ transform:scale(0.92); opacity:0.9; }
    100%{ transform:scale(1.18); opacity:0; }
  }
  .host-photo img{
    width:100%; height:100%;
    object-fit:cover;
    border-radius:50%;
  }
  .host-socials{
    margin-top:18px;
    display:flex; gap:12px; flex-wrap:wrap;
  }
  .host-socials a{
    display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;
    padding:8px 16px;
    border:1.5px solid var(--line);
    border-radius:999px;
    font-size:0.82rem;
    font-weight:600;
    color:var(--ink);
    transition:transform .25s ease, border-color .25s ease, background .25s ease;
  }
  .host-socials a:hover{
    transform:translateY(-2px);
    border-color:var(--ink);
    background:var(--ink);
    color:var(--cream);
  }
  .host-role{
    font-size:0.78rem;
    font-weight:700;
    letter-spacing:0.1em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--orange-1);
  }
  .host h3{
    font-size:1.7rem;
    margin-top:8px;
  }
  .host p{
    margin-top:14px;
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    max-width:56ch;
  }

  /* ---------- CLOSING CTA ---------- */
  .closing{
    background:linear-gradient(150deg, #1E1B2E, #100D19);
    color:var(--cream);
    padding:110px 0;
    text-align:center;
  }
  .closing h2{
    font-size:clamp(2.1rem, 4.4vw, 3.4rem);
    color:#fff;
  }
  .closing h2 .script{
    color:var(--orange-2);
    font-size:1.15em;
  }
  .closing p{
    margin-top:18px;
    color:#B9B3CF;
    font-size:1.05rem;
    max-width:52ch;
    margin-left:auto; margin-right:auto;
  }
  .closing .hero-ctas{ justify-content:center; margin-top:38px; }

  /* ---------- FOOTER ---------- */
  footer{
    background:var(--ink);
    color:#9C97B5;
    padding:36px 0;
    font-size:0.85rem;
  }
  .footer-inner{
    display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:14px;
  }
  .footer-inner a{ color:var(--cream); font-weight:600; }
  .socials{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; }

  @media (max-width: 860px){
    .hero-inner{ grid-template-columns:1fr; }
    .benefits{ grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr); }
    .host{ grid-template-columns:1fr; text-align:center; }
    .host-photo{ width:140px; margin:0 auto; }
  }
  @media (max-width: 540px){
    .wrap{ padding:0 20px; }
    .benefits{ grid-template-columns:1fr; }
    .step{ grid-template-columns:40px 1fr; }
  }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
    .hero h1 .accent,
    .marquee-track,
    .step-signal span,
    .host-photo::after{
      animation:none !important;
    }
    .reveal{ opacity:1; transform:none; transition:none; }
  }
  /* ---------- CURSOR SPOTLIGHT ---------- */
  .cursor-glow{
    position:fixed; inset:0;
    z-index:2;
    pointer-events:none;
    background:radial-gradient(560px circle at var(--mx,50%) var(--my,50%), rgba(238,92,43,0.16), transparent 70%);
    transition:opacity .3s ease;
  }
  @media (pointer:coarse){ .cursor-glow{ display:none; } }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){ .cursor-glow{ display:none; } }

  /* ---------- HEADLINE SCRAMBLE ---------- */
  .scramble-word{ display:inline-block; }
  .hero-visual{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    width:100%;
  }
  /* ---------- LIVE SHORTS ROW (sequential relay playback) ---------- */
  .shorts-wrap{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(2, 1fr);
    gap:8px;
    margin-top:32px;
    width:100%;
  }
  .shorts-frame{
    position:relative;
    width:100%;
    aspect-ratio:16/9;
    border-radius:14px;
    overflow:hidden;
    background:#0F0D18;
    box-shadow:0 10px 24px -10px rgba(23,21,34,0.35);
    transition:transform .3s ease, box-shadow .3s ease;
  }
  .shorts-frame:hover{
    transform:translateY(-6px);
    box-shadow:0 18px 34px -14px rgba(23,21,34,0.45);
  }
  .sf-thumb{
    position:absolute; inset:0;
    width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover;
    z-index:1;
  }
  .sf-thumb::after{ content:''; }
  .shorts-frame::before{
    content:'';
    position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:2;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0,0,0,0) 55%, rgba(0,0,0,0.55) 100%);
    pointer-events:none;
  }
  .sf-player{
    position:absolute; inset:0;
    width:100%; height:100%;
    z-index:3;
    opacity:0;
    transition:opacity .35s ease;
    pointer-events:none;
  }
  .shorts-frame.active .sf-player{ opacity:1; }
  .sf-player iframe{
    position:absolute; inset:0;
    width:100%; height:100%;
    border:none;
  }
  .sf-play-ic{
    position:absolute; top:50%; left:50%; transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
    width:32px; height:32px; border-radius:50%;
    background:rgba(255,255,255,0.92);
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    z-index:4;
    transition:opacity .25s ease;
  }
  .shorts-frame.active .sf-play-ic{ opacity:0; }
  .sf-play-ic::before{
    content:'';
    border-style:solid;
    border-width:6px 0 6px 10px;
    border-color:transparent transparent transparent var(--orange-1);
    margin-left:3px;
  }
  .shorts-click-catch{
    position:absolute; inset:0;
    z-index:5;
    display:block;
    cursor:pointer;
  }
  .shorts-badge{
    position:absolute; top:8px; left:8px; z-index:6;
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap:5px;
    background:rgba(15,13,24,0.6);
    backdrop-filter:blur(4px);
    padding:3px 9px 3px 7px;
    border-radius:999px;
    pointer-events:none;
    opacity:0;
    transition:opacity .25s ease;
  }
  .shorts-frame.active .shorts-badge{ opacity:1; }
  .shorts-badge .dot{
    width:5px; height:5px; border-radius:50%;
    background:#E24C3A;
    animation:recBlink 1.3s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .shorts-badge span{
    font-family:'Inter',sans-serif; font-size:0.56rem; font-weight:700;
    letter-spacing:0.07em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#fff;
  }
  @keyframes recBlink{
    0%,100%{ opacity:1; }
    50%{ opacity:0.35; }
  }
  .shorts-caption{
    grid-column:1 / -1;
    width:100%;
    margin-top:6px;
    text-align:center;
    font-family:'Inter',sans-serif; font-size:0.82rem; color:var(--ink-soft);
  }
  @media (max-width:520px){
    .shorts-wrap{ grid-template-columns:repeat(2, 1fr); gap:6px; }
  }


  /* ---------- FORM SECTION ---------- */
  .form-section{
    background:var(--cream);
    padding:80px 0;
  }
  .form-card{
    max-width:640px;
    margin:0 auto;
    background:#fff;
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius:22px;
    padding:44px 40px;
    text-align:center;
    box-shadow:0 24px 60px -28px rgba(23,21,34,0.18);
  }
  .form-card .eyebrow{ display:block; margin-bottom:10px; }
  .form-card h2{
    font-family:'Archivo',sans-serif;
    font-weight:800;
    font-size:1.7rem;
    letter-spacing:-0.01em;
    margin-bottom:10px;
  }
  .form-card p.form-sub{
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    font-size:0.95rem;
    max-width:44ch;
    margin:0 auto 28px;
    line-height:1.6;
  }
  .form-embed-frame{
    width:100%;
    height:640px;
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius:14px;
    overflow:hidden;
    background:#f3ede2;
  }
  .form-embed-frame iframe{
    width:100%; height:100%; border:none; display:block;
  }
  .form-card .btn{ margin-top:24px; display:inline-flex; }
  .form-fineprint{
    margin-top:16px;
    font-size:0.76rem;
    color:var(--ink-soft);
  }
  @media (max-width:600px){
    .form-card{ padding:32px 22px; border-radius:18px; }
    .form-embed-frame{ height:560px; }
  }

  /* ---------- LOGO INTRO SPLASH ---------- */
  #introScreen{
    position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:300;
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    background:linear-gradient(160deg, #1E1B2E, #0F0D18);
    cursor:pointer;
    transition:opacity .55s ease, visibility .55s ease;
  }
  #introScreen.hide{
    opacity:0;
    visibility:hidden;
    pointer-events:none;
  }
  .intro-logo{
    width:min(64vw, 300px);
    opacity:0;
    transform:scale(0.82);
    animation:introPop 1s cubic-bezier(.2,1.4,.4,1) forwards;
  }
  @keyframes introPop{
    0%{ opacity:0; transform:scale(0.8); }
    60%{ opacity:1; transform:scale(1.05); }
    100%{ opacity:1; transform:scale(1); }
  }
  .intro-hint{
    position:absolute; bottom:38px; left:0; right:0;
    text-align:center;
    font-family:'Inter',sans-serif; font-size:0.72rem; font-weight:600;
    letter-spacing:0.1em; text-transform:uppercase;
    color:#6E6884;
    opacity:0;
    animation:introHintFade 1s ease forwards;
    animation-delay:1.1s;
  }
  @keyframes introHintFade{ to{ opacity:1; } }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
    .intro-logo{ animation:none; opacity:1; transform:none; }
    .intro-hint{ animation:none; opacity:1; }
  }
</style>
</head>

<script>
  // live shorts row — sequential relay playback across four separate frames
  (function(){
    const order = ['sf-0','sf-1','sf-2','sf-3','sf-4','sf-5'];
    const frames = order.map(id => document.getElementById(id)).filter(Boolean);
    if(frames.length === 0) return;

    let idx = 0;
    let player = null;
    let inView = true;

    function clearActive(){
      frames.forEach(f => f.classList.remove('active'));
    }

    function movePlayerInto(frame){
      const mount = frame.querySelector('.sf-player');
      if(player && player.getIframe && mount){
        mount.appendChild(player.getIframe());
      }
    }

    function goToIndex(i){
      idx = i;
      const frame = frames[idx];
      clearActive();
      movePlayerInto(frame);
      if(player && player.loadVideoById){
        player.loadVideoById(frame.dataset.video);
      }
    }

    function playNext(){
      goToIndex((idx + 1) % frames.length);
    }

    function onPlayerStateChange(e){
      // only reveal the video / hide the play icon once it is truly playing
      if(e.data === YT.PlayerState.PLAYING){
        clearActive();
        frames[idx].classList.add('active');
      }
      if(e.data === YT.PlayerState.ENDED){
        playNext();
      }
    }

    function onPlayerReady(e){
      e.target.mute();
      movePlayerInto(frames[idx]);
      e.target.playVideo();
      startVisibilityWatch();
    }

    function onPlayerError(){
      // if a short is blocked/unavailable, skip gracefully to the next one
      playNext();
    }

    function createPlayer(){
      const mount = frames[0].querySelector('.sf-player');
      const holder = document.createElement('div');
      holder.id = 'shortsPlayerMount';
      mount.appendChild(holder);
      player = new YT.Player('shortsPlayerMount', {
        videoId: frames[0].dataset.video,
        playerVars: {
          autoplay: 1, mute: 1, controls: 0, modestbranding: 1,
          playsinline: 1, rel: 0, loop: 0
        },
        events: {
          onReady: onPlayerReady,
          onStateChange: onPlayerStateChange,
          onError: onPlayerError
        }
      });
    }

    if(window.YT && window.YT.Player){
      createPlayer();
    } else {
      const tag = document.createElement('script');
      tag.src = 'https://www.youtube.com/iframe_api';
      document.head.appendChild(tag);
      const prevReady = window.onYouTubeIframeAPIReady;
      window.onYouTubeIframeAPIReady = function(){
        if(typeof prevReady === 'function') prevReady();
        createPlayer();
      };
    }

    // pause when the row scrolls out of view, resume when back in view —
    // only starts watching once the player is ready, and debounces rapid
    // true/false flicker caused by fonts/images/layout settling on load
    let visibilityStarted = false;
    let debounceTimer = null;
    function startVisibilityWatch(){
      if(visibilityStarted || !('IntersectionObserver' in window)) return;
      visibilityStarted = true;
      const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries)=>{
        entries.forEach(entry=>{
          inView = entry.isIntersecting;
          clearTimeout(debounceTimer);
          debounceTimer = setTimeout(()=>{
            if(!player || !player.playVideo) return;
            if(inView) player.playVideo();
            else player.pauseVideo();
          }, 400);
        });
      }, { threshold:0.3 });
      io.observe(frames[0].closest('.shorts-wrap'));
    }
  })();

  // headline scramble / decode-in effect
  const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  function scrambleWord(el, delay){
    const finalText = el.dataset.text || el.textContent;
    if(reduceMotion){ el.textContent = finalText; return; }
    const glyphs = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ#%&*+=';
    const len = finalText.length;
    setTimeout(()=>{
      let frame = 0;
      const totalFrames = 22 + len * 3;
      const timer = setInterval(()=>{
        let out = '';
        for(let i=0;i<len;i++){
          const lockFrame = 10 + i * 3;
          if(frame >= lockFrame){ out += finalText[i]; }
          else if(finalText[i] === ' '){ out += ' '; }
          else{ out += glyphs[Math.floor(Math.random()*glyphs.length)]; }
        }
        el.textContent = out;
        frame++;
        if(frame > totalFrames){
          el.textContent = finalText;
          clearInterval(timer);
        }
      }, 32);
    }, delay);
  }
  let scrambleStarted = false;
  function startHeadlineScramble(){
    if(scrambleStarted) return;
    scrambleStarted = true;
    document.querySelectorAll('.scramble-word').forEach((el, i)=>{
      scrambleWord(el, 150 + i * 260);
    });
  }

  // logo intro splash
  (function(){
    const intro = document.getElementById('introScreen');
    if(!intro){ startHeadlineScramble(); return; }
    let dismissed = false;
    function dismissIntro(){
      if(dismissed) return;
      dismissed = true;
      intro.classList.add('hide');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
      startHeadlineScramble();
      setTimeout(()=>{ intro.remove(); }, 600);
    }
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    intro.addEventListener('click', dismissIntro);
    const autoDelay = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches ? 900 : 3600;
    setTimeout(dismissIntro, autoDelay);
  })();

  // marquee ticker
  const track = document.getElementById('marqueeTrack');
  if(track){
    const phrase = ['Real Conversations.', 'Real Impact.', 'Let\'s Talk Careers.', 'The HR\'s Universe by Recruvate.'];
    for(let rep=0; rep<2; rep++){
      phrase.forEach((t,i)=>{
        const s = document.createElement('span');
        if(i % 2 === 1) s.className = 'dim';
        s.textContent = t;
        track.appendChild(s);
      });
    }
  }

  // scroll progress bar
  const progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
  window.addEventListener('scroll', ()=>{
    const h = document.documentElement;
    const scrolled = (h.scrollTop) / (h.scrollHeight - h.clientHeight) * 100;
    progressBar.style.width = scrolled + '%';
  });

  // scroll reveal
  const revealEls = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
  const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries)=>{
    entries.forEach(e=>{
      if(e.isIntersecting){
        e.target.classList.add('in');
        io.unobserve(e.target);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold:0.15 });
  revealEls.forEach(el=>io.observe(el));

  // cursor spotlight
  const glow = document.getElementById('cursorGlow');
  if(glow && window.matchMedia('(pointer:fine)').matches){
    window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e)=>{
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--mx', e.clientX + 'px');
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--my', e.clientY + 'px');
    }, { passive:true });
  }
</script>

</body>
</html>
